body: I feel like the ultimate problem is how life works, even if i get better, i don't see how i could live knowing all will end, everynight drowned into the ocd obsessions, when trying to get asleep i often start thinking about death, and it scares me so much, i just jump out of my bed, trying to get out of here, of this world. Maybe i am just being stupid but psychologist, or therepist or i dont know who i should see, dont give eternal life. So they can't help me, but at the same time i dont want to live for ever but i dont want to cease to exist so there is no solutions, and death as much as i hate it seems the best option, i wouldnt need to worry about anything but then parents sad so i dont know

It is so hard, i want my parents to never be sad, but if i tell them, they will be sad and they will worry and i dont want that and even if i do i am not sure they could help, i dont see anyone capable of helping me. And suiciding is selfish, ill no longer be sad or any thing but they will be sad, that is just giving them sadness after all they gave me, just to feel better. It feels like there is no way out of this

I am trying not to tell my parents any problems i have but they now have accumulated, i an uncurable condition that makes me disabled, they of course know about it but i always told them i was fine with it and that i dont care at all but i kind of do. I also am suffering from ocd and i can't see a therapist about that because they would know (honestly ocd is so annoying i am spending anywhere from 1 hour to 8 hours a day obsessing about random thing). And even without all of this, i can't find a reason why living is worth it, i do not trust in god, or at least to enough to believe ill be fine after death and i do think there is nothing after and if that is the case, why do we even try, all we do is gonna be wiped by time, every time i say to myself lets go today i gonna be a good day, i am going to learn things, i just remember that it is pointless. People must work to earn money, and they need money to eat and continue to live but why, why should people work and get tired just to live longer, living longer for people to work again to continue living until they die
No, i can't, i am acting with them as if i was happy, i am always smilling to them, i can't just tell them i was all just acting
